description: Raise MATRIX_LR for Muon from 0.04 to 0.05.
Add a short LR warmup by setting WARMUP_RATIO to 0.03.
Lower Muon cautious weight decay from 0.2 to 0.1.
Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.
Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more training time is spent at peak LR.
Set DEPTH=10 with ASPECT_RATIO=51 so model_dim rounds to 512 (4 heads of 128), giving a deeper, narrower model.
Set HEAD_DIM from 128 to 64 so the model has 12 heads instead of 6; n_kv_head follows n_head via build_model_config, and FA3 supports head dim 64.

description: Clip the global gradient norm to 1.0 after the accumulated backward passes and before optimizer.step().
Replace the linear LR warmdown with a cosine-shaped decay from 1.0 to FINAL_LR_FRAC over the warmdown phase.
Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4 for the Adam token embeddings.
Halve the Muon momentum warmup ramp from 300 to 150 steps (0.85 to 0.95).
Set DEPTH=6 with ASPECT_RATIO=85 so model_dim rounds to 512 (4 heads of 128), giving a smaller, faster model that sees more tokens in 300 s.
Reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**17 (grad accum 1 with device batch 64 at seq len 2048) to get about 4x more optimizer steps in the fixed 300 s.
Set WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSS" so all layers except the last (forced to long by the code) use half-context sliding windows, for faster steps.
Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**17 (more optimizer steps in 300 s) and lower MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to offset noisier gradients.

description: Replace the ReLU^2 MLP with a SwiGLU MLP (hidden 1344 at n_embd 512, matched params), with the down projection zero-init and all matrices in Muon.
Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**18 (grad accumulation 2 at device batch 64), keeping other hyperparameters unchanged.
Replace the ReLU^2 MLP with a SwiGLU MLP (gate and up projections of hidden size 1344 at n_embd 512, zero-init down projection), with all matrices still going to Muon.
Set WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.7 so the LR decay phase covers a larger fraction of the training budget.
Set EMBEDDING_LR=0.4, MATRIX_LR=0.05 and WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.3 together to test whether the small single-run gains add up.
